project.name: Baobab ERP Integration Bundle
project.description: Shared library bundle used by the other Baobab OSGi extensions to reach the baobab-app HTTP service (modules/application/server.py) -- the boundary through which code running inside iDempiere's own JVM reaches the baobab Postgres schema, since it has no direct database access of its own. See ADR-ERP-005. Exports packages for other bundles to compile/import against; registers no OSGi service of its own.

configuration.bnd: Bundle-SymbolicName: org.nabhold.baobab.erp.integration Bundle-Vendor: Nabhold Group Africa Export-Package: org.nabhold.baobab.erp.integration Import-Package: *
